Exports: guardedJourneyPath(path) (paths under journeyPrefix() that are not createPath(), not an ACTION_SLUG amend/cancel-amend/copy/delete, not the import-type entry surface), hasCommittedNotificationAnswers(answers) (obligationByName + not the flow-only importType key + not systemPopulated() + isAnswered), entryGuardTarget(request, h) redirecting a fresh journey's deep link to pagePath(journeyId, importTypePage.slug). Register body mirrors routes-live-animals.js call-for-call in the LOAD-BEARING order of the §4.4.3 14-row table: (0) `registerSetMount('plant-products', '/plant-products')`, then `server.ext('onPreAuth', (request, h) => { enterSetContext('plant-products'); return h.continue })` as the first extension, with the WHOLE body wrapped in `await withSetContext('plant-products', async () => { … })` so the boot gates read this set; (1) configureObligationSet('plant-products', plantProductsObligationSet) — namespace import carrying .obligations/.groups/.policy; (2) configureFulfilmentRegistry('plant-products', featureEvaluationBindings); (3) NO configureCommodityReference — FD-5: its only consumer is the L2 live-animals mapper, so under per-set keying the plant slot is simply never filled and a plant request that somehow reached that mapper throws loudly instead of mapping with live-animals vocabulary; (4) configureJourneyFlow('plant-products', { sections, taskRows, rowStatus, nextRunTarget, flowOnlyKeys: FLOW_ONLY_KEYS, entryGuardTarget, layout: LAYOUT }); (5) assertObligationPurity(); (6) assertFulfilmentBindingCoverage(); (7) buildDispatch('plant-products', dispatchPages); (8) configureRecords('plant-products', records) — the SET-OWNED impl (FD-5); (9) configureSession('plant-products', session, SESSION_COOKIE_NAMES) — the L2 set-agnostic session impl plus the plant cookie names; (10) registerJourneyCookie(server, { base: '/plant-products', cookieNames: SESSION_COOKIE_NAMES }) so the three plant cookies carry path '/plant-products'; (11) server.ext('onPreHandler', …) entry-guard wrapper verbatim — realm-scoped, so it never fires on live-animals routes; (12) NO countries.prime()/ports.prime() — plant reference data is fixture-backed and the L2 primed caches are live-animals machinery; (13) server.route(allRoutes) with PREFIX-FREE paths (the mount comes from the registration option in router.js).

notes: AMENDED 2026-08-01 for Sam's rulings R3 (co-residency) and R6 (recipe first) — RETITLED, which reflects a genuine scope change. 'Boot under SERVED_SET=plant-products' is now wrong in fact: there is no served-set env var. The definition of done is CO-RESIDENT — one Node process serves live-animals at the root AND plant-products under /plant-products, proven by co-residency.test.js in a single boot. R6 also changes this increment's RELATIONSHIP TO THE RECIPE: docs/add-a-set.md is authored FIRST, by pp-053, and this increment FOLLOWS it verbatim the way add-a-field.md / add-a-page.md / add-a-collection.md are followed, citing the step each file executes. It is no longer the source from which a recipe is later extracted; that ordering was what left gap G-A open. Hence the new dependsOn pp-053. ID CONVENTION for the reversal's new increments: pp-056 = P-9 set-context; pp-057 = P-10 URL namespace; pp-058 = P-11 setId-first tripwire; pp-053 = G-A/R6 add-a-set.md. WHAT THE REVERSAL ADDED TO THIS INCREMENT'S FILE LIST: routes-plant-products.js now carries registerSetMount + the realm-scoped onPreAuth context entry + the withSetContext wrapper + setId as the first argument of every configure*/buildDispatch call + a per-set registerJourneyCookie(server, { base: '/plant-products', cookieNames }) — the 14-row call table of §4.4.3, not the old 13-row one; routes.js gains the barrel's SECOND line; src/server/router.js is a NEW file to touch (the separate prefixed register call, which pp-006 deliberately left to this increment because the plant gateway did not exist then); co-residency.test.js is EDITED (the plant half) rather than created.
